Everyone’s building AI agents

Almost no one knows which orchestration framework to use 

Here’s how to stop winging it :

⭕️ Use n8n when:

 • You’re integrating LLMs with tools
 • Your flow is trigger → AI → action
 • You want fast, no-code deployment
 • You don’t need agent memory

 ⭕️ Use LangGraph when:

 • Your agents need to think, loop, reflect
 • You want memory + state across steps
 • You’re building logic trees, retries, branching 
  paths
 • You need observability

The rise of Muse AI isn't changing what people want. It's changing how they get there.

For decades we were trained to search, compare, and evaluate across multiple sites. Now, the personal AI becomes the new middleman. Research becomes conversations and recommendations. Execution becomes a command. Same intent, but the experience is new and better for users. 

There's a lot to like from a user perspective, but it could fundamentally change how many businesses acquire and retain customers.
